description: Returns the top 10 of the Buildix Top Traders ranking of large Hyperliquid accounts: address, label, Trader Score, confidence, style badge and, once the ranking exists, the official rank, Verified flag, Follow Score, follower PnL over 30 days and rank 24 hours ago. The Follow Score is what a copier would have kept; score_version says how: v3 assumes a copy 10 minutes late, v4 simulates a fixed 2% stop, fees and slippage on a sampled price path. Wallets with a losing lifetime record, market makers and hedged books are not ranked. Position changes under $50,000 are not seen. Use it to pick Hyperliquid wallets to study before copy trading. Data only: Buildix does not execute trades.

detail.description: "brief" (default) returns labels and key numbers. "full" adds the underlying values, data age and method notes.

name: get_top_traders
title: Top traders by Follow Score
